Run in, kill, done. If I die, kills are recorded server-side automatically, and I respawn here.

Actually wait — safer alternative with better score: nothing else nearby. Let me go for the wizard. Walk nonstop: 3221,3218 → 3114,3169. ~2 min. Kill ~20 sec. Return not needed.
